# Clang-on-Compiler-Explorer probe for #3872, full pane output.
#
# Produced by:
#   triage.py godbolt --issue 3872 --source godbolt-clang-probe.hlsl \
#     --compilers "hlsl_clang_trunk:-T cs_6_4 -E CSMain -DNO_RATE -fsyntax-only,
#                  hlsl_clang_trunk:-T cs_6_4 -E CSMain -fsyntax-only,
#                  hlsl_clang_trunk:-T vs_6_4 -E VSRateMain -fsyntax-only,
#                  dxc_trunk:-T vs_6_4 -E VSRateMain"
# and kept here because the tool overwrites manual-case-godbolt-verify.txt with
# whichever link is published last. The published link for this issue is the DXC
# one; this probe is supporting evidence, and its own link is
#   https://godbolt.org/z/9f9Ej334T
#
# Why a separate, smaller source: Clang parses the whole translation unit, so
# asking it about the issue's real subject (hull and domain control-point
# signatures) would bury the answer under unrelated parse errors. The probe
# therefore asks the one question Clang can still answer.
#
# READ THE FIRST PANE FIRST. It is the same file, same compiler, same flags,
# with the declaration preprocessed out by -DNO_RATE. It exits 0. The second
# pane differs from it in exactly one thing -- the declaration is back -- and
# exits 1. So the diagnostic below is caused by the semantic and not by the
# pane, the flags, or Clang's incomplete DXIL backend.
#
# Result: Clang trunk does not model SV_ShadingRate at all today; it rejects
# the name outright with "unknown HLSL semantic". It therefore cannot yet
# reproduce, or disagree with, the table decision this issue is about -- which
# is consistent with the issue's own 2024 comment that this is something to
# think about for the semantic work in Clang. The fourth pane is DXC on the
# same file, confirming the file is valid HLSL.
# Compiler Explorer panes for #3872, full output.
# Written by `triage.py godbolt` -- rerun it to re-derive.
# CE runs Linux Release builds: it corroborates the local
# Debug build and never overrules it.
